content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-234. - Monthly operation statement.
content.summary:
A recapitulation of all fund balances, location of same and all investments shall
               be included in the monthly operation statement.
(Code 1960, § 9-3(c); Code 1981, § 2-12)
State Law reference—
Financial reports, C.R.S. § 31-20-304.
